compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: AP7313-33SAG-7 assigns IN (VIN) whereas LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB assigns OUT (VOUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 2: AP7313-33SAG-7 assigns OUT (VOUT) whereas LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB assigns IN (VIN) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

parameter_matrix.note: Wider operating Vin window supports broader rail & battery chemistry headroom.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_b_value: Ceramic OK · >=0.1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (VIN vs VOUT), Pin 2 (VOUT vs VIN). Soldering LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB onto a AP7313-33SAG-7 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs significantly (AP7313-33SAG-7: 1 µF p.10 vs LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB: 0.1 µF p.11); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: AP7313-33SAG-7 is rated to only 6 V rec. (7 V abs max, p.4) vs LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB at 30 V rec. (35 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB supplies up to 100 mA (p.5) compared to AP7313-33SAG-7 at 150 mA (p.4); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs by 750 mV (AP7313-33SAG-7: 150 mV p.5 vs LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB: 900 mV p.5); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo at cold/hot corners.
engineering_verdict: AP7313-33SAG-7 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-3) and LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-3) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (VIN vs VOUT), Pin 2 (VOUT vs VIN). Key datasheet deltas: Iq is 55 µA (p.5) vs 2000 µA (p.5), max output current is 150 mA (p.4) vs 100 mA (p.5), recommended Vin,max is 6 V (p.4) vs 30 V (p.4), typical dropout is 150 mV (p.5) vs 900 mV (p.5), and ceramic capacitor stability is supported vs supported. Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 207 vs 269.6 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
